goal.summary: Build a fully automated factory producing at least one automation-science-pack per game minute from natural resources.

roadmap.why_it_matters: Produce 50 new iron plates through the enabled smelting recipe to satisfy the exact steam-power trigger. This technology has no unresolved prerequisites. Preserve the eight held plates for construction.
Produce 10 copper plates through the enabled smelting recipe to satisfy the exact electronics trigger. Compare reuse of the iron equipment against a dedicated copper cell using fresh costs and rates.
After both electronics and steam-power are researched, verify the lab recipe is enabled and produce one lab to satisfy the exact automation-science-pack technology trigger.

After verifying equipment unlocks and material costs, install water intake, connect a boiler and establish steam, connect an engine, then verify electrical operation under load. Preserve observation boundaries between these connections.

After the science-pack recipe unlocks, bootstrap the 10 automation-science-pack required by automation research, power and supply the lab, and verify automation completes before crafting assembling-machine-1. Do not assume higher-tier assemblers are unlocked.

Verify any further machinery prerequisites before construction. Establish automatic iron and copper supply, furnace fuel delivery and power-generation fuel delivery from natural resources, sized using live rates.

Build automatic gear and science assembly with unblocked output storage. Validate actual logistics connections and sustainable transport capacity, then verify at least one automation-science-pack per minute over a full window without hand-fed ingredients.

coal_step.description: Gather a bootstrap reserve of at least 20 coal.

execution_guidance.approach: Hand-mine enough natural coal to hold 20 for the iron bootstrap.
execution_guidance.rationale: The complete inventory contains no fuel. Live drill and furnace rates imply about 15.6 coal for 50 plates; 20 provides startup margin without building a separate fuel-production cell yet.
constraints: Finish with at least 20 coal held.
Preserve the eight held iron plates.
Permanent fuel automation remains required later.

failed_step.description: Fuel the connected iron cell, produce and collect at least 50 new iron plates, verify steam-power is researched, and retain at least 58 iron plates.

execution_guidance.approach: Fuel both exact machines, verify operation, and collect 50 newly smelted plates while preserving the original eight.
execution_guidance.rationale: The ideal drill-limited production time is 200 seconds, excluding travel and setup. Direct feeding avoids manual ore transfers and supports later demand; extra cells are optional, not necessary for this trigger.
constraints: Require steam-power researched and at least 58 held plates.
Fuel both machines; direct ore feed does not supply fuel.
Use output checkpoints and recheck the exact trigger.

plan: Gather a bootstrap reserve of at least 20 coal.
Install the held burner-mining-drill over iron ore; observe its new identity and actual output geometry before choosing furnace placement.
Install the held stone-furnace to receive the drill’s observed output; observe the furnace identity and verify the direct-feed connection before fueling.
Fuel the connected iron cell, produce and collect at least 50 new iron plates, verify steam-power is researched, and retain at least 58 iron plates.
